fadingLines.name: Granny Sachi
fadingLines.text: There you are, child! You went pale as paper. Sit by the post a moment. The Lantern needs rest too.

fadingLines.name: Kaze
fadingLines.text: Oi. You faded. Next time, shift back before the light gets thin. I can’t carry you.

fadingLines.name: Mio
fadingLines.text: (The Lantern is warm in my hands again. I should keep an eye on its light.)

notes.title: The Lantern
notes.text: Press Q (or Tab / ◐) to Shift between the Near Shore and the Far Shore. Going to the Far costs 10 Lumen and drains 0.5/s; coming back is free.

notes.title: Lantern Posts
notes.text: Posts glow with safe light: free Shifts, no drain, no wandering spirits. Use one to rest (full restore) or save.

notes.title: Dash
notes.text: Hold Shift (or press » on touch) to dash. Options → Always Dash flips it.

notes.title: Parley
notes.text: Spirits have a Mood meter (pink bar). Parley raises it; hits lower it. At full Mood a spirit is Calm and can be Sent onward for a kinder reward.

notes.title: Echo & Weaknesses
notes.text: Hit a weakness to build Echo (up to +45% damage for the whole battle). Weaknesses are recorded in the Bestiary.

notes.title: The Far Shore
notes.text: Walls, rocks and doors differ between realms. If something blocks you, try the other shore.

notes.title: Saving
notes.text: Save anywhere: Menu → Save (10 slots). The game also autosaves on every map change, after battles, and before bosses.
